teachers.bio: Jasurbek has taught ielts writing & speaking for 9 years and gives written feedback on every essay.
Sarah has taught academic english for 11 years and gives written feedback on every essay.
Nigora has taught ielts reading & listening for 7 years and gives written feedback on every essay.
Timur has taught general english for 6 years and gives written feedback on every essay.
Emily has taught conversation & pronunciation for 8 years and gives written feedback on every essay.
Dilshod has taught grammar & error correction for 10 years and gives written feedback on every essay.
Kamola has taught young learners for 5 years and gives written feedback on every essay.
Bekzod has taught band 7+ strategy for 8 years and gives written feedback on every essay.
Laura has taught essay & research writing for 12 years and gives written feedback on every essay.
Shahnoza has taught foundation english for 4 years and gives written feedback on every essay.

courses.name: General English
courses.description: Grammar, vocabulary and everyday conversation built up level by level.

courses.name: IELTS Preparation
courses.description: All four bands with weekly mock tests and written examiner-style feedback.

courses.name: IELTS Intensive
courses.description: A short, demanding course for students who already have a test date booked.

courses.name: Speaking Club
courses.description: Two hours of discussion, debate and role-play with no textbook in sight.

courses.name: Kids English
courses.description: Songs, games and stories that teach children to use English, not memorise it.

courses.name: Grammar Booster
courses.description: A focused repair course for the tenses and articles that keep slipping.

courses.name: Academic English
courses.description: Essay writing, seminar language and research reading for university applicants.

courses.name: Beginner English
courses.description: Start from the alphabet and finish able to hold a simple conversation.

hero.title: Your English. Your future.
hero.subtitle: English, IELTS and the confidence to actually speak. Small groups, teachers who mark every essay by hand, and a progress report you can read every month.

about.title: A school built around one question: can you use it?
about.body: TJ Language School opened in Tashkent with eight students and one classroom. We teach General English, IELTS preparation, Academic English and Kids English — but the method behind all of them is the same. Every lesson ends with students producing language, not recognising it. Every essay comes back marked by the teacher who set it. Every month, students get a written report of what improved and what did not.
about.mission: Har bir o‘quvchiga xalqaro darajadagi English bilimini berish va uning kelajakdagi imkoniyatlarini kengaytirish.

faq.question: IELTS kursi qancha davom etadi?
faq.answer: Standart IELTS kursi 4 oy (48 dars), intensiv kurs esa 2 oy davom etadi.

faq.question: Darslar qachon bo‘ladi?
faq.answer: Guruhlar ertalab 09:00 dan kechqurun 19:30 gacha ishlaydi, haftada 3 marta, 90 daqiqadan.

faq.question: Beginner o‘quvchilar qabul qilinadimi?
faq.answer: Ha. Beginner Start kursi alifbodan boshlanadi va oldingi bilim talab qilinmaydi.

faq.question: Ro‘yxatdan o‘tgach nima bo‘ladi?
faq.answer: So‘rovingiz administratorga yuboriladi. Tasdiqlangach, o‘zingiz tanlagan parol bilan login qilasiz.

faq.question: Oylik to‘lov qancha?
faq.answer: Kursga qarab 350 000 so‘mdan 850 000 so‘mgacha. Aniq narx har bir kurs kartasida.

faq.question: Trial lesson bormi?
faq.answer: Ha, bitta bepul sinov darsi va bepul joylashuv testi bor.

faq.question: Sertifikat beriladimi?
faq.answer: Kursni yakunlagan va davomati 80% dan yuqori o‘quvchilarga sertifikat beriladi.

faq.question: Homework qanday beriladi?
faq.answer: Har bir vazifa shaxsiy kabinetingizda chiqadi: matn, havola va muddat bilan.
